title: Robotic Multimodal Weld Inspection Using Vision–Tactile Sensing
summary: A robot-arm inspection platform that fuses tactile depth and RGB-D imaging to automatically scan and flag weld defects.
bullets: Developed a robotic weld-inspection platform integrating a robot arm, GelSight Mini tactile sensor, and Intel RealSense D555, automating force-controlled 10×10 surface scans at 4 N contact.

Built the end-to-end ROS2 pipeline for coordinate mapping, GelSight depth reconstruction, image alignment, multimodal stitching, and defect annotation, producing a 3,600-sample vision–tactile dataset.
